study: UK House of Commons 2024 election official constituency-level results
unit: UK constituency; up to 650, 4 nations and English regions
prespecified_exclusions: Only missing electorate/turnout or no winner-runner candidate votes for computation; report exclusions and special Speaker/NI observations; don't discard by result
classification: All cycles exploratory until independently replicated; contemporaneous margins and vote shares are post-election, cannot be used in genuine pre-election prediction.
A: Does electoral fragmentation (effective number of vote-getting candidates) add association with turnout beyond the winner margin in the same 2024 UK constituencies?

B.H1: Fragmentation positive partial effect conditional on margin
B.H0: No incremental effect or weaker than simple regional baseline
B.Halt: Higher fragmentation dilutes winner vote shares but ecological differences dominate.

C: From every constituency candidate record calculate ENP=1/sum((candidate_votes/valid_votes)^2), verify candidate totals against original constituency CSV; Spearman ENP vs turnout, OLS turnout~margin + ENP + nation fixed effects with robust SE; compare with margin-only, describe all missingness.
F: ENP and margin both constructed from final vote counts, high collinearity/endogeneity; coefficient not causal.
G: Candidate CSV shares publisher and election; no genuine source independence.
I: Do not score named candidates or parties
J: If candidate original inaccessible mark blocked/not executed, use different new source; do not invent ENP.
